title: Tenders (preview)
description: Preview of the new tender configuration, for trying out the form in the Config Portal. Store Data does not deliver it to the stores. Payment methods (tenders) accepted at the point of sale. Choose the tender type first. Every setting the point of sale supports is offered for every type, and every setting left empty uses the default for the type. Store Data adds every technical setting the point of sale needs (payment plugins, provider codes, currency) and delivers the list to the stores. The 'id' identifies a tender and must be unique in the list.
$comment: Preview kind for the Config Portal only: Store Data does not subscribe to it, so nothing reaches a till. The content is the planned che.tender.v3, which is created once this schema is stable; the mapping described here applies to that kind. Read by Store Data (Store Data Resolver and Store Data Connector), which maps each tender to the tender message for ER POS and the Checkout Engine. Scope: every combination the Checkout Engine supports can be configured. A combination is refused only when it breaks the till: an exception, a sale that cannot be completed or cancelled, or change that cannot be paid. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express must be checked by Store Data before delivery: a minimum is not above its maximum; the change tender exists in the list, is enabled, is not loyalty points, allows refunds and has no minimum refund and no minimum per entry, because change is paid as a refund line on it and is otherwise never paid (loyalty points need a loyalty customer on the sale); a default cash tender exists (an enabled cash drawer tender not set to No); the currency matches the business unit; a rounding unit is a multiple of the smallest unit of the currency it rounds, because a finer unit gives amounts the payment plugins and the till cannot pay; the own currency suits the payment plugin: two decimals for a cash changer, at most two decimals for integrated mobile payment, SEK for Swish. Never rename an id: transactions, reports and ERP integrations reference it. The few settings without meaning for a tender are ignored, not rejected, because the Config Portal keeps hidden values: currency on every type except foreign currency (the Checkout Engine converts only foreign currency), provider on standalone mobile payments, change settings when the tender gives no change, a threshold without a change tender, a rounding unit with no rounding, and on cash blocked refunds and minimum amounts, because change on cash is paid as a cash refund. A cash changer tender always gets payRemainingAmount on, because the machine needs the full amount due. exactAmountOnly and refund.blockRefunds are replaced by behavior.overpayment and refund.refundsAllowed; they stay in the schema so that tenders saved earlier still load, and are read only when the new field is empty: exactAmountOnly true means EXACT_AMOUNT, blockRefunds true means NO. Optional text fields accept null as empty, because CCC stores the null the portal writes for a removed field. Amounts and the rounding unit are plain numbers, because the Config Portal renders a number input only for type "number"; the choice fields refuse null too. Clearing a saved amount or one of those choices is therefore refused until the portal deletes a cleared field instead of writing null; choosing the default option works where the field has one. change.tenderId accepts null, which means change in the default cash tender. The Config Portal form (ui-schema/che.tender.preview.json in hiiretail-config-portal-ui-schema-config) is generated from this schema by tools/che.tender.preview/build_ui.py in that repository, which reads the type default groups in $defs to show change and refund settings only where they take effect.

id.title: Tender ID
id.description: Unique code of this tender, 1 to 4 capital letters, digits, '-' or '_'. The point of sale stores at most 4 characters. Transactions, reports and ERP integrations reference it, so never reuse or rename it: renaming creates a new tender. Examples: 'CASH', 'VISA', 'SWSH'. Loyalty redemption and loyalty gift certificates must use the payment code of the loyalty system.

type.title: Tender Type
type.description: What kind of payment this is. Choose it first: the other settings depend on it. Changing the type of a tender that is already in use makes Store Data replace the tender at every store.

oneOf.title: Cash
oneOf.description: Notes and coins in the store's own currency.

hardware.title: Cash Handling
hardware.description: How cash is taken. A cash changer machine counts the cash and pays out change by itself, and the till must also have the cash changer enabled. A cash changer tender cannot be the default cash tender: a store with one also needs a cash tender with a cash drawer as its default, for tills without a machine. A cash changer works only when the store's own currency has two decimals. Empty means cash drawer.

oneOf.title: Cash drawer, handled by the cashier
Foreign Currency Cash
oneOf.description: Notes and coins in another currency than the store's. The till converts the amount due with the exchange rate of this currency.

oneOf.title: Credit / Debit Card
oneOf.description: Payment card read by a card terminal.

terminal.title: Card Terminal
terminal.description: How the terminal is connected. An integrated terminal receives the amount from the till; its payment provider is set up for the store and checkout in Hii Connect, not here. On a standalone terminal the cashier types the amount.

oneOf.title: Standalone, the cashier types the amount
Mobile Payment
oneOf.description: Payment with a mobile app such as Swish or Vipps. An integrated mobile payment works only when every amount on the sale has at most two decimals, so not in a currency with three decimals. Not supported by ER POS.

integration.title: Connection
integration.description: Integrated: the till connects to the payment service, which checks every payment. Standalone: the cashier checks the payment by hand, and the till registers the amount without any check.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The mobile payment service. Required when integrated, ignored when standalone. Swish works only in SEK. The provider's credentials are set up for the tenant by Extenda Retail.

oneOf.title: Electronic Gift Card
oneOf.description: Gift card whose balance is held in a gift card system. Integrated, the default when 'Connection' is empty: the card and its balance are checked online through Hii Connect. Standalone: the till accepts the card without any check, so use it only where the cashier checks the card in the gift card system.

integration.title: Connection
integration.description: Integrated: the till connects to the payment service, which checks every payment. Standalone: the cashier checks the payment by hand, and the till registers the amount without any check.

oneOf.title: Gift Certificate
oneOf.description: Paper gift certificate with a fixed value.

oneOf.title: Voucher
oneOf.description: Voucher with a value, for example a credit note.

oneOf.title: Check
oneOf.description: Paper check. Does not refund unless 'Refunds' allows it.

oneOf.title: Manufacturer Coupon
oneOf.description: Coupon issued by a manufacturer and used as payment.

oneOf.title: Loyalty Points Redemption
oneOf.description: Payment with the customer's loyalty points. Needs a loyalty customer on the sale.

oneOf.title: Organization Charge
oneOf.description: Purchase charged to a business customer's account.

creditCheck.title: Check Credit Limit
creditCheck.description: When on, the till checks the business customer on the sale and their credit limit before accepting the tender. When off, the tender is accepted without any customer or credit check.

oneOf.title: House Account
oneOf.description: Purchase charged to a customer account held by the store.

oneOf.title: Food Stamp / SNAP
oneOf.description: Food stamp or SNAP benefit. Pays for any item unless an item restriction limits it.

oneOf.title: WIC Check
oneOf.description: WIC benefit check. Pays for any item unless an item restriction limits it.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the foreign currency, for example 'EUR'. Required for foreign currency cash, and ignored for every other type, which uses the store's own currency. It must be one of the currencies configured for the stores and differ from the store's own currency.

name.title: Display Name
name.description: Shown on the till and printed on receipts. Examples: 'Cash', 'Visa / Mastercard', 'Swish'.

description.title: Internal Description
description.description: Note for administrators. Not shown to cashiers or customers.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Removes the tender from the stores but keeps its configuration here, so it can be enabled again. A disabled tender cannot be the change tender of another tender.

restrictionRuleId.title: Item Restriction
restrictionRuleId.description: Id of the item restriction rule that limits which items this tender can pay for. Without one, the tender pays for any item, also a food stamp or WIC tender: the till does not check benefit eligibility by itself. The kind that holds these rules is not available yet, so a tender with a restriction is not delivered to the stores until it is.

behavior.title: At the Till
behavior.description: How the till handles this tender. Every setting is optional: a setting left empty uses the default for the tender type.

defaultTender.title: Default Tender of Its Type
defaultTender.description: The till uses the default tender of a type when a payment names only the type, and the default cash tender decides the store's change and cash rounding. Automatic (default): this tender becomes the default when no enabled tender of its type is set to 'Yes' and it is the only enabled one of its type not set to 'No'. Cash changer tenders are left out of this count and are never the default cash tender. When a type has several enabled tenders, set 'Yes' on exactly one of them, or 'No' on all but one. Foreign currency is the exception: with several foreign currency tenders the till always asks the cashier which currency, and Yes only pre-selects that currency in the list, so none has to be Yes.

overpayment.title: Overpayment
overpayment.description: Whether the customer can pay more than the amount due with this tender, and whether the difference is given back as change. Type default: allowed with change for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers and checks; exact amount for every other type. 'Allowed, no change' keeps the overpaid amount, for example a voucher worth more than the purchase; the cashier confirms before the sale completes. Change goes to the store's default cash tender or to the alternate change tender on the Change tab.

exactAmountOnly.title: Exact Amount Only (replaced)
exactAmountOnly.description: Replaced by 'Overpayment'. Kept so that tenders saved earlier still load; when 'Overpayment' is empty, on means exact amount only. Choose an 'Overpayment' option to replace it.

exclusive.title: No Split Payment
exclusive.description: When on, this tender must pay the whole amount due on its own: no other tender may be on the sale, and it always takes the exact amount, whatever 'Overpayment' says. A tender with a fixed value, such as a gift certificate, voucher or coupon, can then only be used when its value equals the amount due.

lockTransaction.title: Lock Sale After Payment Entry
lockTransaction.description: When on, no items can be added, changed or discounted once this tender is entered, and the sale cannot be suspended. The sale can still be completed, the tender line voided, or the sale cancelled. It cannot be on together with 'Block Cancelling the Sale': the sale would then be stuck until it is paid in full.

blockCancel.title: Block Cancelling the Sale
blockCancel.description: When on, a sale that contains this tender cannot be cancelled and the tender line cannot be voided; the sale can only be completed, or suspended with a manager override. It cannot be on together with 'Lock Sale After Payment Entry'.

payRemainingAmount.title: Pay Remaining Amount Automatically
payRemainingAmount.description: When on and no amount is given, the till uses the full remaining amount and skips the amount prompt. Intended for terminals and unmanned checkouts. On foreign currency the till then accepts only the exact converted amount, so a customer paying with a larger note gets no change. A cash changer tender always takes the full remaining amount.

prefillAmount.title: Pre-fill Amount Prompt
prefillAmount.description: When on, the amount prompt on interactive tills starts with the remaining amount instead of zero.

cashDrawer.title: Cash Drawer
cashDrawer.description: Whether the cash drawer opens when a sale paid with this tender is completed. Type default: opens for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers, checks, coupons and manufacturer coupons, which go into the drawer, and stays closed for every other type. Choose 'Open the drawer' for paper food stamps and WIC checks; electronic benefit cards need no drawer. Change given in cash always opens the drawer.

change.title: Change
change.description: Where change goes when the customer pays more than the amount due. Leave empty to give all change in the store's default cash tender. Used only when 'Overpayment' gives change; the type default gives change for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers and checks.

tenderId.title: Alternate Change Tender
tenderId.description: Id of the tender that pays change instead of cash, for example a gift certificate that issues the remainder as a new certificate. It may be this tender itself. It must be an enabled tender in this list, not loyalty points, that allows refunds and has no minimum refund and no minimum per entry: change is paid as a refund with that tender, and the sale cannot complete if the refund is refused. With an integrated card, mobile payment or electronic gift card, the payment plugin must accept a refund without an original payment.

threshold.title: Use Alternate Above
threshold.description: Change above this amount goes to the alternate change tender; this amount or less is given in cash. Leave empty to send all change to the alternate change tender. Ignored without an alternate change tender.

autoCompleteLimit.title: Complete Change Automatically Below
autoCompleteLimit.description: Change below this amount is given automatically. Change of this amount or more must be handled by the cashier before the sale completes. Leave empty to always give change automatically.

refund.title: Refunds
refund.description: Whether money can go back to the customer with this tender, and the limits for it. Leave empty for the type default.

refundsAllowed.title: Refunds
refundsAllowed.description: Whether this tender can be used when money goes back to the customer. Type default: allowed, except for checks, coupons, manufacturer coupons, food stamps, WIC checks, loyalty points, standalone mobile payments and standalone electronic gift cards. Cash always allows refunds, because change is paid out as a cash refund; the setting is ignored for cash. A loyalty points refund needs a loyalty customer on the sale.

blockRefunds.title: Block Refunds (replaced)
blockRefunds.description: Replaced by 'Refunds'. Kept so that tenders saved earlier still load; when 'Refunds' is empty, on means refunds are blocked. Choose a 'Refunds' option to replace it.

skipAmountPrompt.title: Skip Amount Prompt on Receipt Refunds
skipAmountPrompt.description: When on, a refund against the original receipt refunds the remaining amount of this tender without asking the cashier for an amount.

maxAmount.title: Maximum Refund
maxAmount.description: Largest amount that can go back to the customer in one entry with this tender. Above it, a manager must approve. On cash this also limits change. Leave empty for no limit. Ignored when refunds are blocked.

minAmount.title: Minimum Refund
minAmount.description: Smallest amount that can go back to the customer in one entry with this tender. Must not be larger than the maximum. Ignored for cash, where it would block change. Leave empty for no minimum.

limits.title: Amount Limits
limits.description: Limits on how much can be paid with this tender. Leave a limit empty for no limit.

maxPerSale.title: Maximum per Sale
maxPerSale.description: Largest total that can be paid with this tender in one sale, over all its entries.

maxPerEntry.title: Maximum per Entry
maxPerEntry.description: Largest amount for a single entry of this tender.

minPerEntry.title: Minimum per Entry
minPerEntry.description: Smallest amount for a single entry of this tender, including change and refunds paid with it. A remaining amount below it cannot be paid with this tender. Must not be larger than the maximums. Ignored for cash, where it would block change.

rounding.title: Rounding
rounding.description: Rounds amounts paid with this tender, for example to the smallest coin in use. Leave empty, or choose 'No rounding', for no rounding. The amount due is rounded with the default cash tender's rounding: a tender with a coarser unit that gives no overpayment cannot pay a remainder that is not a multiple of its unit.

method.title: Rounding Method
method.description: Whether amounts are rounded, and which way an amount exactly between two units goes. 'Round in one direction' rounds every amount the same way, up or down, as set for the whole till installation, not per tender.

precision.title: Round To
precision.description: The smallest unit amounts are rounded to, for example 0.05 or 1. Amounts the cashier types must be a multiple of it. It must be a multiple of the smallest unit of the store's currency, for example not 0.025 in a currency with two decimals. Ignored without a rounding method or with 'No rounding'.

extraAttributes.title: Extra Attributes
extraAttributes.description: Only use when Extenda Retail support asks for it. Each entry is identified by its name ('id'). Names starting with 'Pos.' are advanced point-of-sale settings that this form does not offer, for example manager overrides of limits or account number capture; Store Data rejects names that duplicate a setting in this form. Other names are passed to point-of-sale extensions.

allOf.$comment: Foreign currency cash names its currency.
A rounding method needs a rounding unit.
A cash changer cannot be the default cash tender: tills without a machine need a cash drawer default.

Lock and block cancelling together leave a sale stuck: no items, no suspend, no void of the tender line and no cancel. Disabled tenders are checked too, like every other per-tender rule, so the error shows where the two settings are saved and not later when the tender is enabled.
At most one enabled tender per type is set to Yes as default.
When a type has several enabled tenders that are not set to No (cash changers excluded), one of them must be Yes, so the default is unambiguous.
At most one enabled cash changer tender per list.
A cash changer needs a cash tender with a drawer, for tills without the machine.

kindGivesChangeByDefault.$comment: Types whose type default for behavior.overpayment is WITH_CHANGE; every other type defaults to EXACT_AMOUNT. Read by the Store Data mapping and by the form generator; the overpayment help text names the same types.

kindRefundsBlockedByDefault.$comment: Types whose type default for refund.refundsAllowed is NO; standalone mobile payments and standalone electronic gift cards default to NO too, and every other type to YES. Read by the Store Data mapping and by the form generator; the refunds help text names the same types.
